purpose: Freeze a backend-independent method schematic that maps every knowledge-construction stage to its formal object, trust boundary, guarantee class, empirical decision and prohibited extrapolation.

figure_contract.results_level_question: How does the system turn benchmark failures into versioned modeling knowledge while preventing the proposer from changing the correctness boundary?
figure_contract.core_conclusion: Benchmark-grounded knowledge construction is a bounded library transition in which untrusted proposals are reduced by retained witnesses, admitted only with declared proof obligations, deployed through exact-fallback routing and promoted only by an independent endpoint.

a.title: Typed skill and versioned library
a.role: define the learned object and immutable boundary
nodes: library L_t=(skills,public router,trusted verifier,frozen endpoint,lineage ledger)
untrusted proposer outside the trusted boundary
theory_links: Proposition S9 and Corollary S9.1 for conditional complexity control
a.guarantee_class: formal object and assumption-conditional complexity interpretation
a.prohibited_inference: Do not depict free-form prompt text as certified knowledge, imply that the proposer may modify the verifier, endpoint or sealed ledger, or imply that the current distributed implementation already has one loadable canonical library manifest.

b.title: Counterexample-guided construction
b.role: show how benchmark failures restrict a declared finite hypothesis space
nodes: admitted proof-carrying skill or exhausted grammar
b.guarantee_class: finite-domain software guarantee plus a conditional teaching-rate bound
b.prohibited_inference: Do not show logarithmic convergence without the balanced-witness premise or imply that the current language-model proposer has demonstrated automatic recovery.

c.title: Selective proof-carrying execution
c.role: show the accepted path and exact fallback path
nodes: zero or multiple matches return the previous-library output
c.guarantee_class: conditional accepted-path correctness and deterministic behavior preservation outside unique coverage
c.prohibited_inference: Do not imply universal natural-language correctness, backend infallibility or non-regression inside the accepted region.

d.title: Independent promotion and immutable versioning
d.role: separate verifier acceptance from benchmark usefulness
nodes: correction, regression, both-correct and both-wrong partition
fresh grouped promotion gate with alpha spending
prefix-code-weighted candidate budget and cumulative regression budget
append content-addressed L_(t+1) or retain L_t
theory_links: Proposition S10 anytime control of erroneous promotion
d.guarantee_class: exact accounting identity plus assumption-conditional sequential and candidate-selection error control; benchmark gain remains empirical
d.prohibited_inference: Do not imply that verifier acceptance proves utility, that zero observed regressions proves dominance, that current runs used complexity-weighted promotion, or that a cumulative budget applies across changing targets.

cross_panel_edges.label: durable output scored by frozen endpoint

boundary_labels: Finite grammar and finite verification domain
Formal library state; current canonical manifest not yet implemented
render_time_blocking_checks: Select and persist exactly one plotting backend: Python or R.
Keep the proposer visually outside the trusted boundary in every panel.
Use distinct visual treatments for software guarantees, conditional guarantees and empirical decisions.
Ensure all cross-panel arrows are directional and every loop terminates in either rejection, fallback or a versioned transition.
Render PDF and SVG at 180 mm final width with editable text and a 5 pt glyph floor.
Measure final panel rectangles and pass the 1.5 pt alignment gate, or record an explicit structured-layout exemption.
Run plotting-source validation, PDF text audit and final-PDF collision audit, then inspect all labels and arrows at final physical size.

decision.remaining_blocker: No plotting backend has been selected or persisted; the schematic has not been rendered or visually audited.
